starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

def parse(s):return [list(map(int,r.split())) for r in s.splitlines()]
examples=[(np.array(parse(d1i)),np.array(parse(d1o)),3,8),(np.array(parse(demo)),np.array(parse(outstr)),2,3),(np.array(parse(d2i)),np.array(parse(d2o)),7,0)]
def nearest_eval(metric='man', tie='keep'):
 total=hit=0
 for x,y,sep,bg in examples:
  targets=[(i,j,int(x[i,j])) for i in range(x.shape[0]) for j in range(x.shape[1]) if x[i,j]!=sep and x[i,j]!=bg]
  for i in range(x.shape[0]):
   for j in range(x.shape[1]):
    if x[i,j]!=sep:continue
    ds=[]
    for p,q,v in targets:
     d=abs(i-p)+abs(j-q) if metric=='man' else max(abs(i-p),abs(j-q)) if metric=='cheb' else (i-p)**2+(j-q)**2
     ds.append((d,v))
    dm=min(d for d,v in ds); wins=[v for d,v in ds if d==dm]
    if tie=='keep' and len(set(wins))>1: pr=sep
    elif tie=='mode':
     c=Counter(wins); m=max(c.values()); w=[v for v,n in c.items() if n==m]; pr=w[0] if len(w)==1 else sep

def local_score_all(rad):
 scores=[]
 for x,y,sep,bg in examples:
  hit=tot=0
  for i in range(x.shape[0]):
   for j in range(x.shape[1]):
    if x[i,j]!=sep:continue
    c=Counter(int(x[p,q]) for p in range(max(0,i-rad),min(x.shape[0],i+rad+1)) for q in range(max(0,j-rad),min(x.shape[1],j+rad+1)) if x[p,q]!=sep)
    m=max(c.values()); wins=[v for v,n in c.items() if n==m]
    pr=wins[0] if len(wins)==1 else sep
    hit+=pr==y[i,j];tot+=1
  scores.append((hit,tot))
 return scores
